business.name: Beit el Zaatar
business.description: Lebanese restaurant in Batroun serving mostly manakish in the morning and grills and mezze at night, based on the owner's mother's recipes. It has a terrace facing the sea.
business.location: Batroun old souk, near the church

contact.address: Batroun old souk, near the church
contact.hours: Every day 8am to midnight; in winter closes at 10pm
